# env/.env.local

```dotenv
APP_TITLE_PREFIX=my-site-db

DATABASE_HOST=127.0.0.1
DATABASE_PORT=5432
DATABASE_NAME=my_site_dev
DATABASE_USER=my_site_runtime
DATABASE_PASSWORD=my_site_runtime
```

Before running the app, the migration/seed step still needs owner-level values:

```bash
export WEB_API_MIGRATION_DATABASE_HOST=127.0.0.1
export WEB_API_MIGRATION_DATABASE_PORT=5432
export WEB_API_MIGRATION_DATABASE_NAME=my_site_dev
export WEB_API_MIGRATION_DATABASE_USER=my_site_owner
export WEB_API_MIGRATION_DATABASE_PASSWORD=my_site_owner

cabal run exe:haskell-web-api-db -- migrate-and-seed
```
